title: Eat With a Local : The True Taste of Quebec City
includes: One-way ride on the funicular to the Dufferin Terrace.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Old Quebec and its best tables in a festive and warm atmosphere during this unique gourmet tour!

Led by a licensed local guide, stroll through the picturesque streets of Old Quebec and meet passionate restaurateurs who will introduce you to the best of their cuisine.
